title: Supreme knowledge and the big mystery

flashcards.back: This knowledge is the most sacred and secret, directly perceived, in keeping with Dharma, easy to practise and timeless.
The universe is his expansion; all beings depend on him, but he does not depend on them.
In reality God, creator and sustainer, does not depend on beings, and they do not depend on him.
All beings remain in God without contact, as the mighty wind, moving everywhere, remains in space.

flashcards.front: Who does the work of creation?
flashcards.back: Material nature, under God's supervision. He creates again and again but stays unattached, a witness.
He is the ritual, the offering, the fire, the mantra, father, mother, goal, refuge, origin and end.
He personally looks after the material and spiritual welfare of those who always remember him.

flashcards.front: A leaf, a flower, a fruit, water (9.26)
flashcards.back: Whatever is offered with devotion by the pure-hearted, God accepts and eats.
Whatever you do, eat, offer, give or endure, do it as an offering to God.
Even the most sinful who resolves to worship God with single-minded love is to be regarded a saint.
God is equal to all, none hateful or dear; but those who worship him with love are in him, and he in them.
Fix your mind on God, be devoted, worship him and bow down: with him as goal and refuge, you will reach him.

quiz.text: Why is this called the king of knowledge?

options.B: It is the most sacred, directly perceived and easy to practise

quiz.why: Supreme, secret, in keeping with Dharma, timeless.

quiz.text: "All beings remain in Me as the wind remains in space" teaches:

options.B: God pervades all yet is untouched

quiz.text: Who does the actual work of creation?
God is the ritual, the fire and also:
quiz.why: Everything is a manifestation of God.

quiz.text: What offering does God accept in 9.26?

options.B: A leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, with devotion

quiz.why: Love, not value, makes the offering.

quiz.text: How should the most sinful person who resolves to worship God be regarded?
quiz.why: 9.30: the right resolution makes the saint.

quiz.text: Who may reach the supreme abode by devotion?

options.C: Anyone who takes refuge in God

quiz.why: The path of devotional love is open to all.
